subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Gestational Diabetes: DIPSI, IADPSG, Insulin and Metformin

steps.tx: Glucose intolerance first recognised in pregnancy is **gestational diabetes mellitus**. Placental insulin resistance unmasks limited pancreatic reserve. It raises macrosomia, shoulder dystocia and neonatal hypoglycaemia risks. Careful history taking and examination help place this finding in the right clinical context before treatment is planned.
steps.say: Gestational diabetes is glucose intolerance first recognised in pregnancy from placental resistance.

steps.tx: The Indian single step seventy five gram test diagnosing at two hour value of one forty is the **DIPSI 75 g OGTT**. It needs no fasting and suits low resource settings. One abnormal value diagnoses gestational diabetes under this method. Correlating this finding with imaging and laboratory results prevents both delayed treatment and unnecessary intervention in most patients.
steps.say: The DIPSI test diagnoses gestational diabetes with one non fasting seventy five gram test.

steps.tx: The international fasting test with three thresholds, any one abnormal diagnosing, uses **IADPSG criteria**. Fasting ninety two, one hour one eighty and two hour one fifty three milligrams per decilitre are the cutoffs. It labels more women diabetic than older criteria. Early recognition matters because timely treatment gives clearly better outcomes than waiting for complications to develop first.
steps.say: IADPSG criteria diagnose with any one of three thresholds on a fasting test.

steps.tx: The safest glucose lowering drug in pregnancy, not crossing the placenta, is **insulin**. It remains standard when diet fails to meet targets. Regimens mimic physiology with basal and mealtime doses. Students should connect this fact with the presenting symptoms, since examination questions usually test that clinical link directly.
steps.say: Insulin does not cross the placenta and remains standard when diet fails.

steps.tx: The oral agent increasingly used where insulin is declined or impractical is **metformin**. It crosses the placenta, so counselling covers the limited long term offspring data. About a quarter of women still need added insulin. Documenting this finding clearly in the notes guides the next clinician and supports safe, well planned further management.
steps.say: Metformin is oral and crosses the placenta, with a quarter still needing insulin.

steps.tx: Diabetes present before conception is **pregestational diabetes**. Unlike gestational disease it carries congenital anomaly risk from early hyperglycaemia. Preconception control and folate are its great preventives. When this picture is seen in practice, urgent senior review is wise whenever there is any doubt about severity.
steps.say: Pregestational diabetes carries anomaly risk from early hyperglycaemia unlike gestational disease.

steps.tx: Three month average glucose guiding preconception and pregnancy control is **HbA1c**. Below six and a half percent before conception minimises anomaly risk. It performs less well in later pregnancy when glucose profiling takes over. Understanding this mechanism explains the symptoms, the investigation findings and the logic behind each step of treatment given.
steps.say: HbA1c guides preconception control, with below six and a half minimising anomalies.

steps.tx: Medical nutrition therapy and postmeal walking are first treatment for most gestational diabetes, termed **lifestyle first**. Eighty percent achieve targets without drugs. Self monitoring four times daily proves whether targets hold. This distinction changes management, so it should be settled early rather than after empirical treatment has already begun.
steps.say: Lifestyle first with nutrition therapy controls most gestational diabetes without drugs.

steps.tx: After delivery most gestational diabetes resolves, but later type two risk is high, needing **postpartum OGTT**. Testing at six to twelve weeks, then regular screening lifelong, catches progression early. Breastfeeding improves maternal metabolism measurably. Careful history taking and examination help place this finding in the right clinical context before treatment is planned.
steps.say: Postpartum OGTT at six to twelve weeks catches later type two diabetes early.
